picks.headline: ElevenLabs upgrades ElevenMusic: adds 'References' style-matching and 'Vocals' voice generation
picks.excerpt: ElevenLabs updated its AI music generator ElevenMusic with two features: 'References,' which lets users set a track's style and mood from 10s-5min of reference audio, and 'Vocals,' which generates original songs using the user's own voice or a voice library. Styles now officially supports the Music v2 model, and uploads must pass copyright checks before use.
picks.rationale: Net-new feature release that directly changes how creators steer AI music tomorrow: reference-audio style control plus own-voice vocal generation on the Music v2 model.
